reading.title: Curiosity Spots Drifting Twilight Clouds
reading.summary: Description NASA’s Curiosity Mars rover captured these drifting clouds on Oct. 31, 2026, the 5,061st Martian day, or sol, of the mission. news.title: Pip review will call for overhaul rather than scrapping benefit for under-25s
news.summary: Recommendations overseen by Stephen Timms would retain system for all ages, unlike last week’s Milburn review A long-awaited review of the personal independence payment (Pip) system will this week recommend that it is overhauled, a week after another report called for it to be partly scrapped. The final report on Pip by a committee co-led by Stephen Timms, the social security minister, is expected to be published as soon as Tuesday, presenting Andy Burnham with one of his most politically sensitive decisions yet as prime minister.
